label: rem:braid-closure-physical-reading
title: Braid closure adds cups and caps, not crossings: two steps, and what an unseen intermediate is
html:
Closing a braid adds a coevaluation (cup) below each strand and an evaluation (cap) above it. It adds no crossing. An observation in this framework inserts a crossing, so closure is not an observation.

Cups and caps as entangled pairs. The coevaluation of V is the maximally entangled vector \Omega of the proposition, item 3. With the pivotal weight K = \mathrm{diag}(q, q^{-1}) on V = R^2 it becomes the q-weighted vector \Omega_K, and the quantum trace of a braid \beta on V^{\otimes n} is \langle \Omega_K, (\beta \otimes 1)\,\Omega_K \rangle. Read: the cups prepare n entangled pairs, \beta acts on one half of each pair, and the caps project back onto the pairs. Each return arc is the entangled partner of its strand.

Two steps. The word closure covers two different maps.

  1. Annular closure keeps the closure axis. It is the map H_n(q) \to \mathrm{HH}_0(H_n(q)) of item 1 of the proposition, and it keeps every character \chi_\lambda separately.
  2. Forgetting the axis sends each block to its quantum dimension. The result is the Markov trace at z = q^3/(q^2+1), which averages the blocks.

What an unseen intermediate is. A process that emits u, runs w, and reabsorbs u^{-1} has the same value as w under every closure (item 2): u passes round the return arc and cancels. More generally, a subword is invisible to every closure exactly when removing it changes the element by a commutator (item 1). This gives a precise meaning to an intermediate that is produced and not seen, without a virtual particle.

Fluid dynamics. The helicity of a vortex tangle is a closure invariant. Its classical counterpart is the asymptotic linking number, in which long orbit segments are closed by short paths whose contribution vanishes in the limit [komendarczyk2008]; the closing arcs are again unseen.

Which physical object the closure axis is (a photon loop, a periodic direction, or nothing) is an interpretation and is not derived here.
